strings.notes: US 0690/0; 惠美 = 0719 #158 Emily (US contact Pokéfan Beverly)

strings.zh: 你的精灵⋯⋯{NEWLINE}好可爱好漂亮！{CLEAR}你也一定非常喜欢精灵吧。{SCROLL}对了！要是你乐意的话,{NEWLINE}我们交换一下电话号码吧？{SCROLL}平时多交流交流吧,{NEWLINE}肯定很有意思的。{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: Your Pokémon is so cute and adorable!{NEWLINE}You love Pokémon just like I do!{SCROLL}Want to trade phone numbers?{NEWLINE}Let’s chat! It’ll be so much fun!{VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 我其实{NEWLINE}很想要一只玛力露。{CLEAR}不过布鲁也很可爱,{CLEAR}所以我也没什么太好埋怨的⋯⋯{SCROLL}啊呀,不是的！{NEWLINE}布鲁,你别当真啊！{CLEAR}其实你才是最可爱的！
strings.en: To be honest, I want a Marill.{NEWLINE}But I make do with my cute Snubbull.{SCROLL}Aw! I’m just kidding!{NEWLINE}I’m just kidding, Snubbull! You’re the{CLEAR}cutest Pokémon ever, really!

strings.zh: 你居然可以带着可爱的{NEWLINE}精灵散步啊！{SCROLL}能把你的电话号码告诉我吗？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: You have such cute and adorable{NEWLINE}Pokémon with you!{SCROLL}We should totally trade phone{NEWLINE}numbers, don’t you think?{VAR:0200:0}
Oh, sorry to keep you waiting,{NEWLINE}{VAR:0103:0}. Here, I’ll give you this.{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 那个,你现在在{NEWLINE}自然公园里吧？{SCROLL}如果是这样的话,{NEWLINE}直接来找我聊天不就好了。
strings.en: Let’s see... You’re in the National{NEWLINE}Park, aren’t you?{SCROLL}Well, you should come talk to me in{NEWLINE}person, don’t you think?

strings.zh: 我把我的{VAR:0100:10}{NEWLINE}打扮了一下,{CLEAR}发现它越来越可爱了！{SCROLL}对了⋯⋯{NEWLINE}前段时间我遇到了{CLEAR}一只野生的布鲁⋯⋯{SCROLL}虽然同样是布鲁,{NEWLINE}但明显我的布鲁{CLEAR}要可爱多了,{SCROLL}我们下次再聊吧。
strings.en: I dressed up my {VAR:0100:10},{NEWLINE}and it’s cuter than ever!{SCROLL}Oh, and... the other day I{NEWLINE}came across a wild Snubbull...{SCROLL}It was a Snubbull too, but{NEWLINE}mine is obviously far cuter.{SCROLL}Let’s talk again soon.

strings.zh: 我把我的{VAR:0100:10}{NEWLINE}打扮了一下,{CLEAR}发现它越来越可爱了！{SCROLL}对了⋯⋯{NEWLINE}前段时间遇到了{CLEAR}一只野生的玛力露⋯⋯{SCROLL}仔细一看,原来是{VAR:0100:11},{NEWLINE}太失望了,{SCROLL}下次再聊吧。
strings.en: I dressed up my {VAR:0100:10},{NEWLINE}and it’s cuter than ever!{SCROLL}Oh, and... the other day I{NEWLINE}came across a wild Marill...{SCROLL}But when I looked closer, it was{NEWLINE}a {VAR:0100:11}. What a letdown.{SCROLL}Let’s talk again soon.

strings.zh: 对了,我家老公{NEWLINE}拿回来了一些金珠⋯⋯{SCROLL}最近经常打扰你{NEWLINE}我觉得挺过意不去的,{CLEAR}我想送你一颗作为谢礼,{SCROLL}我在{VAR:0104:3},{NEWLINE}你有空的就来拿吧。
strings.en: By the way, my husband{NEWLINE}brought home some Nuggets...{SCROLL}I feel bad for bothering you{NEWLINE}so often lately, so I’d like{CLEAR}to give you one as thanks.{SCROLL}I’m at {VAR:0104:3}. Come{NEWLINE}get it whenever you’re free.

strings.zh: 哎？{NEWLINE}哦,金珠啊？{SCROLL}放心吧！{NEWLINE}我不会到别的地方去的,{SCROLL}所以你不用那么着急,{NEWLINE}我就在{VAR:0104:3},{CLEAR}等你有空了就来拿吧。
strings.en: Pardon? Oh, the Nugget?{SCROLL}Don’t worry! I’m not going anywhere,{SCROLL}so there’s no need to rush.{NEWLINE}I’m at {VAR:0104:3}.{CLEAR}Come get it when you have time.

strings.zh: 你的精灵们都还好吗？{NEWLINE}下次再来和我聊聊{CLEAR}关于精灵的话题吧。
strings.en: Are your Pokémon in prime form?{NEWLINE}Let’s chat about Pokémon again.
